classification: receipt-total candidate enumeration and provenance enforcement

round_2_evidence.execution: 12 of 60 iterations, 12 provider requests, and 10 completed tool calls; normal end_turn with no infrastructure or verifier error
round_2_evidence.local_improvement: The previously failing adjusted-total case was corrected by the Round 2 semantic-precedence guidance.
round_2_evidence.new_first_verifier_error: A table heading containing TOTAL triggered an unsafe next-line fallback, selecting an item-row amount instead of a later final payable total.
round_2_evidence.trajectory_diagnosis: The generated parser returned on the first keyword match in each OCR pass and used cross-pass frequency within a coarse rank. It did not enumerate the complete receipt, distinguish table headings, save winner/rejection provenance, or audit semantic calculation stages before materialization.

targets.section: Implementation Gate for Receipt-Total Parsers / Quality Self-Check
targets.description_skill_error: Round 2 stated the semantic policy but did not impose an executable completion gate that forbids first-match returns, rejects TOTAL-bearing item-table headings, restricts next-line fallback, and requires an auditable all-candidate selection trace.
targets.gold_repair: Require full-receipt candidate enumeration before selection; reject item-table headings; allow next-line fallback only for independent payable labels; rank candidates by eligible calculation stage before same-class agreement; persist winner and rejection provenance; and block completion when only schema checks, first-match shortcuts, or cross-class frequency voting were used.

leakage_controls.notes: The Skill patch contains general receipt-parser implementation constraints and pseudocode. Concrete failing filenames, OCR text, and oracle values remain only in the manifest and rollout evidence.

offline_full_row_comparison.purpose: diagnostic only; the official verifier remains the scoring authority

artifact_archive.assessment: The live verifier proves the workbook existed during scoring, but the final workbook was not exported for independent replay or SHA verification.

validation.assessment: Round 3 implemented some candidate enumeration and table-heading checks, but ignored the required multi-pass/provenance/audit completion gate and still used simplified amount and date heuristics. The valid rollout failed and is not accepted as Gold.
validation.acceptance_boundary: A valid fresh reward-1 rollout is required before the repaired item is accepted as Gold. This is the third and final planned repair round.

final_attribution.label: agent_did_not_follow
final_attribution.reason: After three repair rounds, the candidate Skill was fully preloaded but the agent continued to omit or approximate explicit requirements: bounded alternative OCR passes, complete candidate provenance, semantic-stage adjudication, rejected-candidate reasons, targeted retries, and the behavioral completion audit. Error count changed from 1 to 4 to 5 across the three valid rollouts rather than converging to zero.
